text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Government studies partial nationalisation of loss-making ship repairer Lisnave.
- Banco Finantia has lodged a request in court asking for the cancellation of the privatisation of Banco de Fomento e Exterior (BFE).
- Banco Espirito Santo (BES) posted 15.8 billion escudos consolidated net profit in the first nine months of 1996, up 17 percent from the same period in 1995.
- Gold reserves at the Bank of Portugal quadrupled during World War Two. Some of the gold belonged to Jews killed by Nazis.

- British American Tobacco (BAT) and RJ Reynolds, two of the world's biggest tobacco companies, prepare to challenge in Brussels a possible decision by the Portuguese government to approve the purchase of Portuguese tobacco company Tabaqueira by U.S. company Philip Morris, sources close to the process said.
